title: Membership
markdown:
# MEMBERSHIP

A CWB Membership gives you access to exclusive events, perks and discounts at The Center for Wooden Boats, plus special offers from local South Lake Union businesses.

[Buy or renew membership](https://centerforwoodenboats2.my.site.com/gs/s/membership)

### Attention: We're transitioning to a new CRM and payment system. If you encounter any issues, please email [membership@cwb.org](mailto:membership@cwb.org). Thank you for your patience and support!

## All members receive the following CWB benefits:
- Monthly eNewsletter
- Up to 20% off classes and workshops
- Up to 25% off boat rentals at [CWB in South Lake Union](https://www.cwb.org/rent)
- 20% off gift shop purchases (excluding CWB Handmade items)
- Exclusive access to purchase [Livery Season Passes](https://www.cwb.org/rent) for unlimited rentals (not motorboats)
- Member discounts on select event admission
- Access to member-only events and classes
- Discounts at local businesses, mostly in South Lake Union — see [CWB Community Discount Partners](https://www.cwb.org/discount-partners-and-benefits)

## Available Membership Add-ons:
- Junior Crew (child addition) — $25

## MEMBERSHIP LEVELS
![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/a363cf98-75e9-4235-b650-014eff0a2773/duck_boatwright.png)
### Boatwright (Individual) - $75
Basic benefits for one adult.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/37a4c5e3-f9fd-44ea-aa46-8b1a6b00831a/ducks_dual.png)
### Dock Wranglers (Dual) - $120
Basic benefits for two adults.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/9934cdb8-b6ed-4e73-b36e-32a9c9dabb6f/ducks_apprentice.png)
### Apprentice (Student) - $35
Ages 18+ with a valid student ID.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/6e0c1766-29f9-4c45-adc8-54fbf947fbce/ducks_boathouse.png)
### Boathouse (Family) - $180
Basic benefits for two adults and up to four children, plus up to 20% off youth camps and programs, and free admission through the [Council of American Maritime Museums (CAMM)](https://councilofamericanmaritimemuseums.org/member-directory/) and [Reciprocal Organization of Associated Museums (ROAM)](https://sites.google.com/site/roammuseums/home/list-of-roam-museums) reciprocal programs.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/c4dca8f1-1515-4718-a367-03008ca90571/ducks_mastercraftsman.png)
### Master Craftsman (Senior) - $35
Ages 62+.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1d509c45-4bff-46d9-92dd-320e6eea5963/ducks_fleetkeeper.png)
### Fleet Keeper (Contributing) - $300
All Boathouse benefits, plus one CWB gift shop hat or T-shirt, one complimentary sail checkout, and 10% off [CWB facility rentals](https://www.cwb.org/facility-rentals).

### IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT MEMBERSHIP:
- Membership is active as soon as payment is complete.
- You must show your membership card to receive discounts at community partner businesses.
- Basic membership contributions are fully tax-deductible. Fleet Keeper contributions are tax-deductible minus the value of any additional perks redeemed.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/bddb54ee-7088-48e9-8bbc-9b22389372fa/2025+Membership+Sticker.png)
